pages.text: Leaves lay ankle-deep on the mountain path. Acorns hid beneath them. Yuki came with a bowl.
"I'll fill this bowl with acorns." Yuki swept the leaves aside with their hands.
Acorns rolled out. Yuki put them in the bowl. "More here!"
Yuki set the bowl under a tree and began filling their pocket instead. "This is much faster."
The pocket bulged. Yuki pushed more acorns inside.
Momo followed, nudging something with their nose. "Don't follow me." The leaves swallowed every sound.
Back at the tree, Yuki turned out the pocket. Only three acorns! "Where did they go?"
Grandma looked inside. A hole had opened at the bottom. "Your pocket got full first."
Now Yuki carried the bowl, dropping acorns in one by one. Rattle, rattle.
The bowl was full. Yuki carried it down with both hands.
